records.applicationTiming: Full SP-36 at planting; urea & KCl split at 7-10, 21-25, 40-45 DAT.
records.applicationMethod: Full SP-36 at planting; Urea and KCl split into three applications at 7-10 days after transplanting (DAT), 21-25 DAT, and 40-45 DAT. Sawah irrigated lowland rice.
records.notes: N 90-120 kg/ha (urea 200-250 kg/ha); P2O5 36-54 kg/ha (SP-36 100-150 kg/ha); K2O 30-60 kg/ha (KCl 50-100 kg/ha).
records.source_org: BB Padi (Balai Besar Penelitian Tanaman Padi), Sukamandi
records.source_title: Indonesian irrigated lowland rice NPK recommendation

records.applicationTiming: Basal at planting; remaining at 25-30 DAP and 45 DAP.
records.applicationMethod: Basal at planting (1/3 N, full P, 1/2 K); remaining N and K applied at 25-30 days after planting and 45 DAP. Hybrid maize.
Entire dose banded alongside seed rows at planting (starter N; biological N-fixation supplies the rest).
records.source_org: Balitkabi (Indonesian Legume and Tuber Crops Research Institute), Malang

records.applicationTiming: 1/3 at 1 month; remainder at 3 months after planting.
records.applicationMethod: 1/3 N, full P, 1/3 K at 1 month after planting; remaining N and K split at 3 months after planting.

records.applicationTiming: Full P + 1/3 N/K at planting; remainder top-dressed at 4-6 weeks.
records.applicationMethod: Full P and 1/3 N/K at planting; remainder top-dressed at 4-6 weeks after planting.

records.applicationTiming: Basal at planting; top-dressed at 1.5 and 3 months.
records.applicationMethod: Basal application in planting furrows; remaining top-dressed at 1.5 and 3 months after planting.

records.micronutrients: NaCl (common salt) 150-225 kg/ha/yr (= 1000-1500 g/tree/yr; chlorine essential for coconut).
records.applicationTiming: Circular trench under canopy in 2 splits (beginning & end of wet season).
records.applicationMethod: Source dose per mature tree/year: N 400-600 g, P2O5 250-350 g, K2O 900-1200 g, NaCl 1000-1500 g. Per-hectare shown at ~150 trees/ha. Kelapa mature.
records.source_org: Balit Palma (Indonesian Palm Crops Research Institute), Manado

records.applicationTiming: Applied across weeded circle and frond stack in 2-3 applications per year.
records.applicationMethod: Source dose per mature tree/year: N 800-1200 g, P2O5 400-600 g, K2O 1200-1800 g, kieserite (MgO) 400-600 g. Per-hectare shown at ~143 trees/ha (9x9 m). Kelapa sawit mature.
records.source_org: IOPRI (Pusat Penelitian Kelapa Sawit - PPKS), Medan
records.source_title: Indonesian oil palm per-tree fertilizer recommendation

records.applicationTiming: Split twice a year (Oct/Nov rainy-season start and March/April).
records.applicationMethod: Split twice a year: October/November at rainy season start and March/April. Mature Robusta/Arabica.

records.applicationTiming: Surface applied in inter-row strips twice a year.
records.applicationMethod: Surface applied in inter-row strips twice a year. Mature tapping trees (karet).
records.source_org: Pusat Penelitian Karet (Indonesian Rubber Research Institute)

records.applicationMethod: 100% basal placement at planting. Kacang tanah.
Basal incorporation into the soil during soil preparation. Kacang hijau.
